snippet.title: RE:AKTOR trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354950/REAKTOR/

RE:AKTOR is a metroidvania action platformer where you can roll back time. Find and install drivers to unlock your lost abilities. Run and fight your way through a branching underground facility. Rewind time to beat the clock, and stop a great cataclysm.
